scope: any conversation that drives EasyEDA/JLCEDA Pro
deployment: INJECTED globally 2026-10-21 as rule 9 of policy/deploy/global-agents.md (trigger plus four iron rules only); read this file for the full ruleset

environment.critical: remove ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE before every CLI call, otherwise Electron runs as node and arguments are treated as script paths

commands.name: open
commands.note: 4.1.60 requires path; bare editor not allowed

invokeRules: timeout upper bound is 60000 ms on 4.1.60; design for 60 s
batch component placement in groups of 20-25
wait 5-10 s after mutations before querying state
never compute pin/pad coordinates; read them back with getAllPinsByPrimitiveId()

schematic.search: eda.lib_Device.search(key, LIB, undefined, undefined, pages, page)
schematic.searchPitfall: omitting LIB returns an empty array without error
schematic.create: eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.create(item, x, y, subPartName, rotation, mirror, addIntoBom, addIntoPcb)
schematic.wire: eda.sch_PrimitiveWire.create([x1,y1,x2,y2,...], net) — endpoints must land on pins; segments must be orthogonal and connected
schematic.netlist: eda.sch_ManufactureData.getNetlistFile(name, 'JLCEDA') -> File object; use await file.text(); not written to disk

pcb.create: eda.pcb_PrimitiveComponent.create({libraryType:'4', libraryUuid, uuid}, layer, x, y) — layer 1=top, 2=bottom
pcb.createPitfall: passing the raw search item fails with Error: [object Object]; must wrap it
pcb.line: eda.pcb_PrimitiveLine.create(net, layer, startX, startY, endX, endY, lineWidth, lock)
pcb.autoRouting: eda.pcb_Document.autoRouting() — only routes nets that already have connectivity; manual placement alone yields {success:false,totalNetsCount:0}

forbidden.behavior: returns true, writes nothing (PCB stays 300 bytes); same on eprj2 and eprj3
returns true, net count stays 0 even after save+reopen
deprecated; hangs until the 60 s invoke timeout

successCriteria: never trust a boolean return value
verify on-disk artifact changed (eprj3 .epcb2 grew from 300 B to ~49 KB)
no reliable schematic-to-PCB sync exists; drive PCB primitives directly

imageToSchematic.identifiers: MPN/package/pin numbers must come from OCR or text layer; VLM output is a candidate only, phrase as suspected
imageToSchematic.output: netlist DSL JSON, not pixel-level reconstruction

dataSafety: client upgrade wipes the projects directory (observed 4.1.60 -> 4.1.78); back up projects first
never run experimental writes against the user's real projects; create a throwaway test project
recovery order: Recycle Bin -> projects-recovery -> database; copy out of the bin with Shell.Application CopyHere, never Restore
workflow: clear ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; run doctor until connected
search with LIB; batch create; read pins; wire; save
export via getNetlistFile/getBomFile -> file.text() or saveFileToFileSystem
openDocument(pcb); create footprints (wrapped, numeric layer); read pads; draw lines; autoLayout; save
prohibitions: no CLI on the browser edition
no pixel-level schematic reconstruction claimed as automatic
no automatic ordering — Gerber must be human-reviewed
